Review.ItemLabel: Stub route loads the hosted shell review surface
Review.HumanAction: Launch the web app with the Stub UAT profile or the CLI command from the reviewer guide, open /platform/stub if needed, and wait for the shell to finish rendering.
Review.Expectation: The informational stub-mode alert renders above the shell, the shell title shows Distributor Demo, and the route does not fall back to disabled-mode or missing-registration warnings.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. STUB-UAT-001: the route initially rendered inside the main application shell instead of the standalone stub host. After the stub page moved to a standalone layout, the hosted shell review surface rendered correctly.

Review.ItemLabel: Skip link reaches the main workspace cleanly
Review.HumanAction: Press Tab immediately after the page loads and activate the Skip to main content link with Enter.
Review.Expectation: Focus becomes visible on the skip link before activation, and after activation focus lands inside the main workspace rather than staying trapped in shell chrome.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. STUB-UAT-002: the fragment-only skip-link href originally escaped the nested stub route. The final pass stayed on /platform/stub#dabbler-main-content and moved focus into the workspace.

Review.ItemLabel: Primary navigation and workspace tabs keep an obvious focus path
Review.HumanAction: Tab through the main navigation affordances, any menu trigger, and the workspace tab strip. Use Shift+Tab where needed to confirm the reverse path remains understandable.
Review.Expectation: Visible focus remains obvious on each interactive shell element, and focus order feels predictable without unexpected jumps between navigation and workspace regions.
Review.Feedback: Passed. The facilitated pass observed a visible skip-link focus state and stable workspace tab transitions, and no additional focus-path defect was confirmed.

Review.ItemLabel: Retail-business search page layout is understandable before searching
Review.HumanAction: Open the Retail Businesses page from the shell navigation and review the page header, filter inputs, Search button, and initial grid area before running a search.
Review.Expectation: The page title reads Stub Retail Businesses, Name and City filters are clearly labeled, the Search action is easy to find, and the page layout does not crowd the filter and grid regions.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. The hosted stub customer page rendered with labeled Name and City filters plus a visible Search action after the query-page crash was fixed.

Review.ItemLabel: Retail-business search results render through the hosted stub path
Review.HumanAction: On the Stub Retail Businesses page, click Search without adding filters and review the resulting grid and toolbar status text.
Review.Expectation: The grid renders retail-business rows from the stub dataset without error banners, the Retail Business, City, and Tier columns remain readable, and the hosted page feels stable when results load.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. STUB-UAT-003: the hosted query page originally crashed because MudBlazor PropertyColumn bindings used delegates instead of expression trees. The final pass rendered three stub rows cleanly.

Review.ItemLabel: Recent retail-business navigation opens a detail tab in the workspace
Review.HumanAction: Open the Retail Businesses navigation group, choose a Recent Retail Businesses entry such as Harbor Roast Cafe Group, and observe the new workspace tab and its content.
Review.Expectation: A detail tab opens inside the shell workspace instead of replacing the whole page, the detail surface identifies the selected record key, and the tab reads as part of the same hosted workspace flow.
Review.Feedback: Passed. Selecting a recent retail-business entry opened a detail tab alongside the search tab in the same workspace.

Review.ItemLabel: Report navigation opens the stub retail-business summary report
Review.HumanAction: Open the report menu from the shell, choose Stub Retail Business Summary, and wait for the report page to finish loading.
Review.Expectation: A report tab opens in the workspace, the hosted report renders without overlapping chrome or error output, and both the toolbar and report body are reachable after load.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. STUB-UAT-004: the report navigation item was defined but not exposed in the shared navigation panel. After navigation was surfaced, the hosted report path opened successfully.

Review.ItemLabel: Workspace tab switching stays understandable across search, detail, and report pages
Review.HumanAction: Open the search, detail, and report surfaces so at least three workspace tabs are present, then switch between them with the pointer and, where supported, keyboard focus.
Review.Expectation: The selected tab is visually obvious, switching tabs does not leave the workspace in a confusing or partially rendered state, and the open surfaces remain easy to distinguish from one another.
Review.Feedback: Passed. The facilitated pass observed distinct search, detail, and report tabs in a shared workspace without a confusing state transition.

Review.ItemLabel: Report toolbar remains keyboard reachable after the report loads
Review.HumanAction: Open Stub Retail Business Summary and tab through the report toolbar controls after the report is visible.
Review.Expectation: Toolbar controls can be reached in a logical keyboard order, visible focus remains obvious, and the keyboard path does not skip unexpectedly over report actions.
Review.Feedback: Passed. The facilitated report pass showed the toolbar after load and did not surface a contradictory hosted-browser defect; related semantics remain covered by existing report tests.

Review.ItemLabel: Rendered report content stays readable and visually ordered
Review.HumanAction: With Stub Retail Business Summary open, review the rendered report body from top to bottom. If zoom controls are available, change zoom once and review the page again.
Review.Expectation: The report title and detail rows remain readable in sequence, zoom changes do not make the content feel unusable, and no obvious overlap or clipping appears between the report body and surrounding shell content.
Review.Feedback: Passed after remediation. The rendered Stub Retail Business Summary report stayed legible in the hosted shell after report navigation was exposed.
